fact: A Nation spot check of major Nairobi police stations in 2020 found the duty officer keying Occurrence Book entries at the station on a desktop, with a tablet as fallback and the paper OB used when both fail, the entry transferred later; Nairobi held 210 desktops and 10,181 tablets, network and power were intermittent, superiors could view station entries, and the Inspector General said the national rollout would be complete in 18 months.
title: Police usher in a bold new era with digital OB
